cards.say: How many metres in one kilometre? one thousand metres.
How many centimetres in one metre? one hundred centimetres.
How many millimetres in one centimetre? ten millimetres.
How many millimetres in one metre? one thousand millimetres.
How many grams in one kilogram? one thousand grams.
How many millilitres in one litre? one thousand millilitres.
How many kilograms in one tonne? one thousand kilograms.

cards.front: What does the prefix kilo mean?
cards.back: One thousand. A kilometre is 1,000 metres.
cards.say: What does the prefix kilo mean? One thousand. A kilometre is one thousand metres.

cards.front: What does the prefix centi mean?
cards.back: One hundredth. A centimetre is 1/100 of a metre.
cards.say: What does the prefix centi mean? One hundredth. A centimetre is one hundredth of a metre.

cards.front: What does the prefix milli mean?
cards.back: One thousandth. A millimetre is 1/1000 of a metre.
cards.say: What does the prefix milli mean? One thousandth. A millimetre is one thousandth of a metre.
three point five kilometres in metres. three thousand five hundred metres. Multiply by one thousand.
two hundred and fifty centimetres in metres. two point five metres. Divide by one hundred.
four kilograms two hundred grams in grams. four thousand two hundred grams. four times one thousand equals four thousand and four thousand plus two hundred equals four thousand two hundred.
seven hundred and fifty millilitres in litres. zero point seven five litres. Divide by one thousand.
zero point six kilograms in grams. six hundred grams. Multiply by one thousand.
forty five millimetres in centimetres. four point five centimetres. Divide by ten.
two point four metres in centimetres. two hundred and forty centimetres. Multiply by one hundred.
five thousand grams in kilograms. five kilograms. Divide by one thousand.
one point five litres in millilitres. one thousand five hundred millilitres. Multiply by one thousand.
three tonnes in kilograms. three thousand kilograms.
twelve thousand metres in kilometres. twelve kilometres. Divide by one thousand.
eight point two five kilograms in grams. eight thousand two hundred and fifty grams.

cards.front: Which is longer, 3 km or 3,500 m?
cards.say: Which is longer, three kilometres or three thousand five hundred metres? three thousand five hundred metres, because three kilometres equals three thousand metres.

cards.front: To change a bigger unit to a smaller unit, do you multiply or divide?
cards.back: Multiply. You need more of the smaller units. Example: 2 m = 200 cm.
cards.say: To change a bigger unit to a smaller unit, do you multiply or divide? Multiply. You need more of the smaller units. Example: two metres equals two hundred centimetres.
